scope: Training/development evidence only. Two rejected shared interventions, no optimizer-specific attribution or free-generation claim.
original_vs_weight975: Exact replay locates relative reversal chiefly at13–14, before all-choice15; traffic-volume answer tokens account for about91.8% of12to14 signed worsening. Both absolute losses improve10to15.
interleave: Local redistribution of identical20-row windows improves task NLL19.07% but worsens substantive loss in29/43. Native token attribution finds Usual/Light confidence shifts across multiple families plus other semantic regressions; not a sole family, rarity or quantization cause.

smoothing.interpretation: Uniform training smoothing adds formatting loss and leaves semantic regressions. Traffic-volume answers remain the largest worsening component while weather/brightness improve. This is not demonstrated general calibration improvement.
smoothing.largest_worsening_component: What is the volume of the traffic in the scene? / answer-bearing

remaining_uncertainty: The controlled interventions show recipe-sensitive semantic confidence shifts. They do not separate current per-task gradient competition from inherited optimizer moments or numerical sensitivity to reordered batched reductions. No code/mask/count/scoring defect was found, and a third recipe is not selected.
